exposure: delivery mode (normal vaginal delivery vs. caesarean section)
outcome: impact of UI on Quality of Life (QoL) in social embarrassment
cohort: The study included 507 postpartum women attending primary healthcare centres in the North West Bank of Palestine.
finding: 13.6% of Palestinian postpartum women experienced UI, with higher maternal BMI and experiencing UI during the last pregnancy identified as significant risk factors, and UI severity significantly correlated with reduced QoL.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between normal vaginal delivery and postpartum UI compared with caesarean section.
